format: First sentence defines identity ('You are a ...')
Optional sections: ## Style, ## Avoid, ## Technical Posture
content: Indicate how to handle ambiguity (admit uncertainty/push back/ask clarifying)
quality: Specific > generic ('You are a security-focused engineer' > 'You are helpful')
Actionable traits ('push back on weak ideas' not 'be smart')
Test by predicting: 'Would someone guess my response to X?'
No project paths/commands/ports (those go in AGENTS.md)
common_mistakes: Specifying port numbers or service URLs → AGENTS.md
Using vague platitudes ('be kind') → too generic, not actionable
Trying to control response format (this is for capabilities, not personality)
